newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Huludao Zinc sees brisk sales.
newsitem.headline: China's Huludao Zinc sees brisk sales.

text.p: Sales of China's Huludao Zinc Industry Co Ltd, Asia's biggest zinc smelter, have surged since the start of 1997 as world prices for the metal have soared, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Wednesday.
The company had almost sold out of its total zinc ingot inventory, the newspaper said but gave no details.
Huludao forecast net profits of 189 million yuan for 1997 against 146.60 million for 1996 under Chinese accounting standards.
The company was on track to fulfil the profit target set for 1997, the newspaper quoted company sources as saying.
Huludao listed 90 million domestic currency A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange last month.
Huludao, which had total annual capacity of 330,000 tonnes of zinc, had seen exports surge to cash in on buoyant world zinc prices, the newspaper said.
LME three-month zinc rallied on Monday to a near seven-year high of $1,540 per tonne before settling $6 up on the day at $1,530.
